findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-prism/src/icc_eval.rs:376-384, :395-414 vs src/wide.rs:1209 WIDE_DESCRIPTOR model ('destination matrix/Gray curves inverted exactly and extended sign-preserving outside 0..1') and clip ('output left unclamped')
findings.evidence: F.1 b) (a y outside the range takes the inverse of the closest y in the range) is applied only at a FLAT end; at a sloped end the table still extrapolates (documented extension). So an out-of-gamut linear value through a table destination whose last run is flat is pulled to x1 (inside 0..1), while the same value through a sloped table leaves 0..1. The descriptor's clip key still says matrix/TRC output is left unclamped; the model key does state the flat-end rule, so the two keys disagree for flat-ended tables. The clip COUNT is taken on the linear values and is unaffected.
findings.remediation: Qualify the clip key: 'unclamped except at a flat end of a destination table (F.1 b)'; or apply one out-of-range rule to both end kinds
